# Norman Douglas

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P0](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0000)</sub>
- **Family:** [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Norman Douglas is a big man who was a handsome, red-haired young giant in his youth. He has a massive head topped with an ungrizzled mane of red hair, an unwrinkled high white forehead, and flashing blue eyes. A long, ruddy red beard sweeps over his broad chest.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015), [v5 CHAPTER XXII. ST. GEORGE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P2](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0002)_

## Personality

Norman Douglas is a clever, well-read, and reclusive individual who is nonetheless known for his bracing, stimulating, and whirlwind presence. Though capable of noisy hilarity, blustering tempers, and wild driving, he possesses a complacent side alongside a tendency toward bullying.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P29](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0029), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P87](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0087), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. ## History

In his youth, Norman Douglas went about with [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md) for two years before quitting her in a fit of pique and marrying [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Reese out of temper. He spent twenty years away from church after a session member cheated him in a cow deal, and he buried his wife ten years after his marriage. Decades later, [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) boldly confronted him, leading him to apologize and agree to attend church monthly and contribute to the minister's salary. He later attended a party where he engaged in a lively argument with [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md). Desiring to marry [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md), Norman confronted her sister [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) and secured her release of Ellen's past promise, though the marriage was stymied when [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) refused to leave [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) living alone.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P29](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0029), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P23](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. ## Quotes

> "Well, a bargain is a bargain. I reckon I can stand it twelve times a year. What a sensation it’ll make the first Sunday I go! And old Susan Baker says I’m going to hell, hey? Do you believe I’ll go there—come, now, do you?"
>
> — Norman Douglas — [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P67](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0067)

> "Hey, Wilson, haven’t you got a smile on yet? Beats all how you women can sulk! I never sulked in my life—it’s just one big flash and crash with me and then—pouf—the squall’s over and the sun is out and you could eat out of my hand."
>
> — Norman Douglas — [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P79](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0079)

> "Listen to her. You can’t cuddle a rooster as you can a kitten. Who ever heard of petting a rooster? Better take little Tom. I want to find a good home for him."
>
> — Norman Douglas — [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P83](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0083)

> "I can’t stand snivelling. If you’ve anything to say, say it and have done. Great Kitty, is the girl possessed of a dumb spirit? Don’t look at me like that—I’m human—I haven’t got a tail! Who are you—who are you, I say?"
>
> — Norman Douglas — [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P34](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0034)

> "‘Evening, girl. Sit down again—sit down again. I want to have a talk with you. Bless the girl, what’s she looking at me like that for? I don’t want to eat you—I’ve had my supper. Sit down and be civil."
>
> — Norman Douglas — [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P4](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ellen-west--norman-douglas.md)

Norman and [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) enjoy lively arguments together and are courting again after many years apart, with intentions to marry. Norman takes an active role in trying to clear the path for their future, even confronting her sister [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) to release [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) from a past promise. However, [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) ultimately refuses to leave [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) alone, placing their plans for marriage on hold.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 CHAPTER XXII. ST. GEORGE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXII. ST. GEORGE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT P21](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0021), +12 more_

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/faith--norman-douglas.md)

Norman and [Faith](../character/faith.md) built a friendship after a fiery confrontation when [Faith](../character/faith.md) visited him to demand he support the minister's salary and return to church. Amused and impressed by her fierce spirit, Norman apologized for his initial outburst and struck a bargain with her to contribute to the salary and attend services in exchange for her friendship. The two reconciled over a shared meal and animated conversation, after which he drove her home with gifts.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P23](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), +5 more_

- Friend of — reconciled over supper after a quarrel  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P60](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0060)</sub>
